name: rqlite
smoke: "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/rqlited" -node-id offline -http-addr 127.0.0.1:14001 -raft-addr 127.0.0.1:14002 "$HOME/rqlite-data" > "$HOME/rqlite.log" 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; ready=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do if printf "SELECT 42;\n.quit\n" | "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/rqlite" -H 127.0.0.1 -p 14001 > "$HOME/query.out" 2>/dev/null && grep -q 42 "$HOME/query.out"; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 0.2; done; test "$ready" -eq 1; grep -q 42 "$HOME/query.out"; kill "$pid"; wait "$pid" || true; trap - EXIT
notes: Official website installer with pinned release and local resource reads. Smoke test starts a single-node server on container loopback and queries SQLite; clustering and external connectivity are outside this test.
